svg.title: Dashboard L7 menu structure: 6 menu utama
svg.desc: Peta navigasi dashboard trading agent dengan 6 menu sidebar dan detail konten setiap halaman

g.text: Navigation

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Detail halaman Dashboard: komponen apa saja, data real-time apa, dan layout')
g.text: Dashboard
1. Dashboard (home)
Portfolio summary: total balance, open PnL, win rate
Active signals: berapa sinyal aktif, pending, closed hari ini
Agent status: running/paused, last scan, Wyckoff phase market
Quick stats: R:R avg, best/worst trade, daily PnL chart

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Detail halaman Signal feed: bagaimana signal card ditampilkan, filter, dan sorting')
g.text: Signal feed
2. Signal feed (halaman utama)
Live signal cards: entry, SL, TP, R:R, direction, reasoning
Filter: by chain, by phase Wyckoff, by confidence score
Status tabs: active | pending trigger | closed | expired
Setiap card expandable → full TA breakdown T0-T4
Click card → buka chart dengan TA overlay

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Detail halaman Scanner: hype scanner, volume anomaly, new listing tracker')
g.text: Scanner
3. Scanner (discovery)
Volume heatmap: semua pair Binance, warna = spike intensity
New listings: Binance + DEX, waktu listing, vol awal
Top movers 24h: sorted by volume, price change, txn count
Sub-tabs: trending | new listings | volume spike | watchlist
Setiap token clickable → langsung masuk TA pipeline

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Detail halaman Charts: TradingView widget, TA overlay, multi-timeframe view')
g.text: Charts
4. Charts (TA workspace)
TradingView widget: candlestick + EMA 13/21 + Stoch(5,3,3)
Multi-TF view: 1W | 1D | 4H | 1H | 15m tabs
S/R zones overlay: area bounce 30-100d otomatis digambar
Signal markers: entry/SL/TP level terplot di chart
Wyckoff phase label: di atas chart, fase saat ini

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Detail halaman Backtest: strategy tester, performance metrics, equity curve')
g.text: Backtest
5. Backtest (learning lab)
Run backtest: pilih pair, date range, parameter TA
Equity curve: grafik pertumbuhan portfolio over time
Stats: win rate, avg R:R, max drawdown, Sharpe ratio
Trade journal: semua trade historis + reasoning + outcome
Learning: agent insights, pattern mana yang paling profit

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Detail halaman Settings: agent config, risk parameters, API keys, notifications')
g.text: Settings
6. Settings (konfigurasi)
Agent: on/off, scan interval, pairs yang dipantau
TA params: EMA period, Stoch setting, min trendline touch
Risk: max risk per trade %, daily loss limit, min R:R
S/R config: lookback days (30/100), bounce threshold
API keys: Binance, optional (CoinGecko, GoPlus)
Notifications: browser push, sound alerts
